title: Deleting a matrix never reprices parts already on a work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and a part on line 1 in category A, cost $100.00, priced at $135.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Delete matrix A from its row's three-dot button.
  3. Click Delete in the question.
  4. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • A question names matrix A and its categories.

Step 3:

  • Matrix A is gone from the list.
  • Category A now shows the General Matrix on the Categories page.

Step 4:

  • The part still reads $135.00.
  • Its Priced by still reads Default.
